vintage: older aem-boilerplate clone with project additions (DM/Scene7 auto-block, section data-image backgrounds, template/theme body classes)
buttonClasses: a.button (bare) / a.button.primary (<strong>) / a.button.secondary (<em>), parent p.button-container (or the block-cell div when the link is its only child)
buttonizationNote:
aem.js decorateButtons: a link that is the ONLY child of a

or

becomes a.button even without emphasis; links inside /
  • or sharing a

    with other nodes stay plain. No accent () slot.
templateBodyClass: metadata `template` -> decorateTemplateAndTheme() adds toClassName(value) to <body> in loadEager, before decorateMain
sectionMetadata: style -> classes on .section; other keys -> data-* (data-sec-spacing etc. consumed by styles.css)
emptySectionNote: local dev server and DA pipeline consume the metadata block into <head>; no empty leading section is emitted
headerOverlay: header.js adds header.header-overlay only when the first section contains .hero-banner; otherwise the header is a solid Komatsu Blue bar (position relative <900px, static >=900px)
globalLinkSkin: styles.css gives every <a> nowrap/ellipsis/Font Awesome ::after; komatsu.css resets a:any-link to inline and ::after to none; main a.button gets the Komatsu outline/filled skin
imageDecoration: authored / pass through untouched (no createOptimizedPicture on block images); buildDynamicMediaImages only rewrites DM/Scene7 URLs carried on
localPreview: http://localhost:3000/content/<path> (dev server renders content/<path>.plain.html with head.html + metadata meta tags)
